results.description:
Believe in the Christmas magic that awaits when you open your heart.
 

When Sadie's life in Miami crashes down, an unexpected inheritance—a quaint candy store in the remote town of Mistletoe, Alaska—offers her a fresh start. Trading palm trees for snow-capped mountains, Sadie finds herself far from the bustling city life she's known, facing not only the biting Alaskan cold but also the painful memories that keep her heart frozen.

But Mistletoe holds more than just chilly air. Enter Martin Kringle, a mysterious toymaker with a twinkle in his eye, a heart full of secrets, and a sassy daughter in tow. Martin's large order for the candy store promises to be more than just a business deal—it could be the spark that rekindles Sadie's joy and melts her guarded heart.

When a snowstorm blankets Mistletoe, Sadie finds refuge in Martin's cozy cabin, where the warmth of the fire and the magic of the season make the walls around her heart begin to thaw. But as sparks fly, Martin knows he must reveal a truth that could shatter the fragile connection they're building and risk everything he's come to cherish.

With Christmas approaching and the future of Mistletoe hanging by a silvery thread, Sadie faces a choice: protect her heart or take a leap of faith. To save her newfound love and the town that's come to mean everything, Sadie will have to believe in the magic of second chances, the power of hope, and the possibility of a Christmas miracle.

Will Sadie's bold plan be enough to weave together the lives, loves, and dreams of those in Mistletoe? Only one thing is certain—in this enchanting Alaskan town, anything is possible with a little Christmas magic.

Don't miss out on a story where the Northern Lights aren't the only magic in the Alaskan sky. Grab your copy now.

Books in the series:

Magic in Mistletoe

Snowflake Sugar

Moonlight Over Mistletoe

Holly and Ivar (November 1, 2025)
